response.sql: WITH per_invoice_price AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_price) AS mean_price FROM Invoice_Line_Items WHERE product_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY invoice_number), per_invoice_lines AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number) SELECT (SELECT AVG(mean_price) FROM per_invoice_price) AS avg_invoice_mean_price, (SELECT AVG(line_count) FROM per_invoice_lines) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice;

assumptions.assumption: Invoices with no line items count as zero line items in the line-item average, so the average runs over every row of Invoices. Invoices with only missing prices are still counted in the line-item average; only the price average skips them.
A line item is a row of Invoice_Line_Items, and a line item with a missing product_price still counts toward the line-item total.

alternatives.interpretation: The line-item average covers only invoices that have at least one line item, so invoices with no lines are excluded from that average as well as from the price average.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_invoice_price AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_price) AS mean_price FROM Invoice_Line_Items WHERE product_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY invoice_number), per_invoice_lines AS (SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number) SELECT (SELECT AVG(mean_price) FROM per_invoice_price) AS avg_invoice_mean_price, (SELECT AVG(line_count) FROM per_invoice_lines) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice;
